title: GOV-0034: implement control 6 — source-digest freshness (a claim cannot rest on a STALE/UNKNOWN source), now that deep-research owns acquisition
problem:
## Observed
Acceptance control 6 ("a changed source digest makes dependent claims stale") has been the long-deferred research control — it awaited a source-fetch mechanism, which `deep-research` (WP-0049) now provides. Today a source carries `uri, source_type, retrieved_at, digest` but **no freshness / re-resolution outcome**, so a claim can rest on a source whose bytes have since changed or that can no longer be resolved, and the gate accepts it.

## Expected
Implement control 6 (not a new control number — the long-pending one):
- Add a source-receipt field `freshness` (`CURRENT` / `STALE` / `UNKNOWN`), required, and an optional `resolved_revision` (an immutable revision — a commit, DOI, versioned URL). `deep-research` sets `freshness` on re-resolution: `CURRENT` when an immutable revision resolves or the digest is unchanged; `STALE` when the bytes changed; `UNKNOWN` when it could not be resolved.
- **Control 6 (gate enforcement):** a claim may not rest on a `STALE` or `UNKNOWN` source (fail closed) — the gate reads the receipt; it does not itself fetch. A stale/unavailable source can remain in the record as documented non-coverage, but it cannot support a claim.
- `freshness` is part of the material evidence, so it is inside the `evidence_digest` (a source going stale is an evidence change — control 17 stays coherent); the three examples are migrated with recomputed digests.

## Evidence
- source schema today: `uri, source_type, retrieved_at, digest` — no freshness/receipt field
- `deep-research` (#89 / WP-0049) established the read-only acquisition contract; control 6 is its named consumer

## Unknowns
None. The gate cannot re-fetch (deterministic, no network) — freshness is `deep-research`'s verdict; the gate enforces the consequence. Not in scope: the other 4 P0 subskills, #77/#83/#84.

## Proposed work package
`BADF-WP-0050`. `freshness`/`resolved_revision` source fields; control 6 in `validate_research_record`; examples migrated + re-digested; acceptance.md marks control 6 enforced (21 of 22); tests + mutation; own G07 self-dossier. C2. `badf-research` stays `DESIGNED` (5 of 9 P0).
